description: Queries an accessible type with typed filters, relationships, locale-aware sorting and database pagination. A filter is {fieldId, operator, value}; single-value operators take a typed scalar value, while in, notIn, all, between and overlaps take values (an array of typed scalars) and value: null. For a multiple choice field, values holds individual {kind: 'select', value: optionId} scalars rather than one selectList value. Multiple choice fields filter with in (any of), all and notIn (none of) and cannot be sorted or grouped. Optional grouping supports single choices, booleans, members, relationships and date buckets, with per-group pages; returned group keys load further pages. Calculated, restricted, missing and failed values are distinct. Decimal values use strings. Formatted text arrives as Markdown between untrusted-content markers.

operator.description: For multiple choice fields in, all and notIn take option values and match records holding any, all or none of them. between uses two inclusive date endpoints in values; overlaps takes the same endpoints and also matches a date range that only partly falls between them; a range without an end counts as its start day. inLastDays and notInLastDays use a positive whole day count in value as a decimal without currency. Range contains tests a point; gt/gte test its start, lt/lte its end. Relative windows begin at UTC midnight that many days before the query clock: inLastDays includes later dates, notInLastDays matches only earlier ones.

anyOf.description: Typed CRM value; only the fields for the selected kind are allowed. A decimal carries a currency, null when it has none. For richText writes send documentJson as a ProseMirror document JSON string, not the Markdown returned on read. A file value lists uploaded file ids in order; the server formats an address value from its parts.

items.description: Typed CRM value; only the fields for the selected kind are allowed. A decimal carries a currency, null when it has none. groupPage.description: Requires grouping. Defaults to 10 records per group, at most 25 materialized groups and 1000 unique records. A returned group key in only and overrides loads another page; collapsed groups retain counts without loading records.

groupSummaries.description: Requires grouping. Aggregate numeric fields over every record in each group, independent of pagination. Relationship groups use full attribution; a source record contributes once per group. Restricted inputs hide the entire summary.

grouping.description: Group by a field, system column or relationship column. Date buckets use UTC boundaries; weeks start on Sunday. At most 50 value groups and one empty group are supported per query.

hidden.description: Group keys the board hides (value:<optionId> or __empty__); Appearance lists them to show again.

hideEmpty.description: The board hides columns without records.

includeIdentities.description: Include registered identifiers for returned records of a list with a contact details (channels) field.

recordIds.description: Match these terminal record identities after following the path; all steps require record access.

searchFields.description: Limit search to these fields of the list (text, URL, address, formatted text, files, contact details). Omitted searches all of them.

fieldId.description: A sortable field id, system:createdAt, system:updatedAt, or system:manual (the list's manual order, asc only).

workspace.description: Slug or id of the workspace to work in. Optional when the account has exactly one usable workspace; required when it has several. An API key always works in its own workspace.
